performance_data.verification_quote: The membrane exhibited high permeability of 1149.3 L m−2 h−1 under 0.1 MPa. For dyes and oils rejection experiment, the membrane revealed extraordinary contaminants resistance performances.
The membrane manifested superior anti-fouling capability and a high permeate flux recovery ratio (~96.9%) for long-term filtration processes.

engineering_constraints.description: BC production: Acetobacter xylinum NUST4.2, static fermentation at 30°C for 24h
BC purification: 0.3% NaOH + H₂O₂ at 80°C for 5h
PDA modification: dopamine 1-3 mmol/L in Tris-HCl (pH 8.5), 180 rpm, 30°C, 18h

narrative.text: Bacterial cellulose produced by Acetobacter xylinum has unique 3D nanofiber network with ultrafine fibers (10-100 nm), high surface area, superhydrophilicity, and excellent mechanical strength. Bio-inspired modification with polydopamine and graphene oxide creates anti-fouling ultrafiltration membranes for water purification.
